create_longcat_flash_config: create a LongcatFlashConfig instance with model architecture parameters for MoE and MLA attention
configure_moe_experts: configure MoE routing with n_routed_experts, moe_topk, norm_topk_prob, and routed_scaling_factor
configure_mla_attention: configure MLA attention with kv_lora_rank, q_lora_rank, qk_rope_head_dim, and v_head_dim
configure_ngram_embedding: configure n-gram embedding with ngram_vocab_size_ratio, emb_neighbor_num, and emb_split_num
initialize_rope_scaling: initialize rotary position embeddings with rope_theta and rope_scaling parameters
